findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/GeneralLinearGroup/Basic.lean:83 `def generalLinearEquiv : GeneralLinearGroup R M ≃* M ≃ₗ[R] M` with `invFun := ofLinearEquiv`; TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/GeneralLinearGroup/Unipotent.lean:86 `theorem isUnipotent_ofLinearEquiv_iff (f : V ≃ₗ[K] V)`; TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Representation/SemisimplePoint.lean:220.
findings.fix: State `Commute (ofLinearEquiv f) (ofLinearEquiv g) ↔ Commute f g` for `f g : M ≃ₗ[R] M` in `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/GeneralLinearGroup/` (matching the existing `isUnipotent_ofLinearEquiv_iff`), and obtain the points case at call sites via `(hgh.map (pointsAction V))`. Route `SemisimplePoint.lean:220-221`, which still open-codes the same `generalLinearEquiv.symm.toMonoidHom` idiom, through it too.
findings.issue: `Comodule.commute_ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction` is stated one level too low: the proof uses nothing about Hopf algebras or comodules, only that `ofLinearEquiv` is the inverse of the `MulEquiv` `generalLinearEquiv`. Baking `pointsAction` into it makes the general fact unavailable elsewhere.

findings.evidence: Grep for `semisimplePart_mul_of_commute|unipotentPart_mul_of_commute|jordanDecomposition_mul_of_commute` over `TauCeti/` hits only the two definition sites and their docstrings — the GL-level versions (LinearAlgebra/JordanChevalley/Commuting.lean:136,164,173) are never applied. The transport lemmas are in place: JordanDecomposition/Basic.lean:161,174 and Tannaka/PointFaithful.lean:115 (already used this way at Basic.lean:253).
findings.fix: Prove `Point.semisimplePart_mul_of_commute` and `unipotentPart_mul_of_commute` by `Tannaka.fgPoint_ext_of_forall_ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction` + `ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction_semisimplePart`/`_unipotentPart` + `map_mul`/`ofLinearEquiv_mul` + the GL-level formula applied to `Comodule.commute_ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction g h hgh`, then get `jordanDecomposition_mul_of_commute` as `Prod.ext` of the two.
findings.issue: `Point.jordanDecomposition_mul_of_commute` re-runs the whole `eq_jordanDecomposition_iff` uniqueness argument instead of transporting `GeneralLinearGroup.jordanDecomposition_mul_of_commute`, which this PR proves at the general level; consequently the GL-level `semisimplePart_mul_of_commute` / `unipotentPart_mul_of_commute` / `jordanDecomposition_mul_of_commute` have no consumer anywhere in the repo.

findings.evidence: SemisimplePoint.lean:214-221 is `intro M; rw [map_mul, LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv_mul]; apply (hg M).mul_of_commute (hh M); …`, identical to Commuting.lean:120-125; `isSemisimplePoint_def` at SemisimplePoint.lean:83 is `Iff.rfl`.
findings.fix: Import `TauCeti.Algebra.AlgebraicGroup.Representation.SemisimplePoint` and discharge the goal with `IsSemisimplePoint.mul_of_commute` (the goal is `Iff.rfl`-equal to `IsSemisimplePoint` by `isSemisimplePoint_def`, with `FGComoduleCat.{u,u,u}` here); this bullet disappears entirely if the previous finding is adopted.
findings.issue: The semisimplicity bullet re-proves `HopfAlgebra.IsSemisimplePoint.mul_of_commute` inline, line for line, while the adjacent unipotence bullet correctly delegates to `IsUnipotentPoint.mul_of_commute`.

summary: Two of the new declarations sit below their natural level: the commuting-action lemma is a `pointsAction`-specific instance of a fact about `ofLinearEquiv`, and the point-level product formula re-proves the linear result the PR itself establishes (which is left with no consumers), including an inline re-proof of the existing `IsSemisimplePoint.mul_of_commute`.
